title: Recall Adjustment Relief Start Day - TRICARE Retired Reserve Training Questions
content:
**Rule (TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Retired Reserve).** The day the recall adjustment relief is counted from follows the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment: where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls inside the period the adjustment covers, the recall adjustment relief is counted from that effective date; where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls before the period the adjustment covers began, the recall adjustment relief is counted from the first day the adjustment covers; otherwise the recall adjustment relief is counted from the plan's termination date.

**What is the period the adjustment covers?** The period the adjustment covers is the run of days covered by the coverage-type adjustment bills for the most recently paid month (the coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles), ending on the last day of that month.

**Which enrollment decides?** The recalled purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment, by its status and effective date.

**The adjustment covers 18 to 31 May and the enrollment is active from 22 May.** Counted from 22 May.

**Same adjustment; the enrollment is applied with an effective date of 10 May.** The effective date falls before the period began, so it is counted from 18 May.

**No applied or active enrollment, or one effective in June.** Counted from the plan's termination date.
